name: cz.jobsai/jobsai
title: JobsAI
description: Czech AI job board: search jobs, apply for consenting candidates, manage a company's job postings.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search public Jobsai job listings.

query.description: Full-text query in Czech or English, e.g. a job title or skill ("skladník", "React").

occupation.description: ISCO-08 occupation code (4 digits, e.g. "2512"); returns only jobs classified with it.

kraj.description: Czech region, exact name of one of the 14 kraje, e.g. "Hlavní město Praha", "Jihomoravský kraj".

remote.description: true returns only fully remote jobs; false or omitted applies no remote filter.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get a public Jobsai job detail by id or slug.

id.description: Job id from search_jobs. Send id or slug.

slug.description: Job slug from search_jobs. Send id or slug.

tools.name: submit_application
tools.description: Submit an application on behalf of the candidate represented by the consent envelope.

jobId.description: Job id from search_jobs or get_job.

coverLetterMarkdown.description: Optional cover letter in Markdown (HTML is stripped).

coverLetterAiAssisted.description: Set true when the cover letter was AI-generated (AI Act Art. 50 transparency; shown to the employer).

useExistingCv.description: Attach the candidate's newest approved CV; without one the call fails with cv_required. false sends no CV.

tools.name: get_application_status
tools.description: Read an application status for the consent-envelope candidate.

applicationId.description: Application id from submit_application or list_applications.

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List all applications for the consent-envelope candidate.

status.description: Return only applications in this status.

tools.name: subscribe
tools.description: Subscribe to application status change notifications for the consent-envelope candidate.

applicationIds.description: Only report changes of these applications; omit to follow all of the candidate's applications.

tools.name: stream_matches
tools.description: Stream new job matches delivered to a candidate by their job alerts. Pass candidate_pseudonym (the consent envelope sub_pseudonym); the candidate must hold an active consent envelope for this agent with matches:read. Without candidate_pseudonym the stream carries no candidate matches.

query_id.description: Saved search id. Not available to agents yet (returns scope_denied).

since.description: Resume point: ISO 8601 time or an SSE cursor. The Last-Event-ID header takes precedence.

candidate_pseudonym.description: sub_pseudonym from the candidate's consent envelope; without it the stream carries no matches.

limit_per_minute.description: Advisory client limit; the server may lower it.

tools.name: withdraw_application
tools.description: Withdraw an application on behalf of the consent-envelope candidate.

applicationId.description: Application id from submit_application or list_applications.

tools.name: saved_jobs
tools.description: List, save, or unsave the consent-envelope candidate's bookmarked jobs.

action.description: list returns the bookmarks; save and unsave change one and need jobId.

jobId.description: Job id to save or unsave; required for save and unsave.

tools.name: propose_action
tools.description: Propose one concrete candidate action (application, job question, interview decision, requirements update) for the candidate's own confirmation. Nothing runs until the candidate confirms.

command.description: Normalized candidate command the human will review. Exactly one actionType variant applies; interviewId exists only on INTERVIEW_ACCEPT / INTERVIEW_DECLINE / INTERVIEW_CANCEL. Field semantics per actionType are documented in docs/agents/mcp.md (actions).

agentNote.description: Optional plain-text rationale shown to the candidate as untrusted agent text. Omit it or send a string; null is refused.

tools.name: get_action_proposal
tools.description: Read the candidate's decision on a proposal: status, the final command including the candidate's edits, and the one-shot approval window.

tools.name: execute_approved_action
tools.description: Execute exactly the command the candidate confirmed, once, while the approval is valid.

proposalId.description: proposalId of a proposal the candidate confirmed (status CONFIRMED).

command.description: Optional: must equal the confirmed command (including the candidate's edits); otherwise approval_mismatch. Same shape as propose_action.command.

tools.name: list_employer_jobs
tools.description: List the represented company's own job postings (drafts included) with status and public visibility window. Needs a representation envelope.

status.description: Return only postings in this status.

tools.name: get_employer_job
tools.description: Get one of the represented company's job postings for editing: full text, salary, verified conditions with revision, editHash and visibility.

jobId.description: Job id (uuid) of the represented company's posting, from list_employer_jobs.

tools.name: list_employer_branches
tools.description: List the represented company's workplaces (branches) for the job conditions workplace field.

tools.name: create_job_draft
tools.description: Create a draft job posting for the represented company. Nothing is public until publish_job.

inputSchema.description: Creates a DRAFT job of the represented company. descriptionCs is plain text or Markdown in Czech (HTML is stripped). salaryRange is optional for a draft but required to publish.

kind.description: Employment type: hpp (employment contract), dpp or dpc (work agreements), brigada (temporary job) or freelance.

descriptionCs.description: Job description in Czech, plain text or Markdown (HTML is stripped).

salaryRange.description: Salary range { min, max } with min <= max. Optional for a draft, required to publish.

salaryPeriod.description: MONTHLY (default) or HOURLY: the period salaryRange refers to.

locationKraj.description: Czech region, exact name of one of the 14 kraje, e.g. "Jihomoravský kraj".

remoteOk.description: Whether the job can be done remotely.

applyMode.description: internal (default): candidates apply on JobsAI; external: they apply at applyUrl.

applyUrl.description: https:// URL where candidates apply; used with applyMode external.

tools.name: update_job
tools.description: Edit a job posting of the represented company (optimistic lock by editHash). Editing an active job is public at once and needs employer_jobs:publish. Changing the title or description raises terms.revision and unconfirms all verified conditions; call get_employer_job again before update_job_terms or confirm_job_terms.

inputSchema.description: expectedEditHash comes from get_employer_job (optimistic lock). Editing an ACTIVE job is public at once and needs employer_jobs:publish.

jobId.description: Job id (uuid) of the represented company's posting, from list_employer_jobs.

expectedEditHash.description: editHash from get_employer_job; a stale value is refused (optimistic lock).

changes.description: Only the fields to change, same names and rules as create_job_draft; at least one.

tools.name: update_job_terms
tools.description: Set the verified conditions of a job (salary basis, bonuses, shifts, start, training, remote mode, workplace). A stale terms.revision returns facts_changed with reason stale_terms_revision: read the job again.

inputSchema.description: terms.expectedRevision comes from get_employer_job.terms.revision. On an ACTIVE job this needs employer_jobs:publish.

jobId.description: Job id (uuid) of the represented company's posting, from list_employer_jobs.

terms.description: Conditions to set; terms.expectedRevision is get_employer_job terms.revision.

tools.name: confirm_job_terms
tools.description: Confirm listed job conditions as stated by the company (renews their evidence).

inputSchema.description: Confirms the listed condition fields as stated by the company (evidence); confirmation.expectedRevision from get_employer_job.terms.revision.

jobId.description: Job id (uuid) of the represented company's posting, from list_employer_jobs.

confirmation.description: Fields to confirm as stated by the company; confirmation.expectedRevision is get_employer_job terms.revision.

tools.name: publish_job
tools.description: Publish a draft or archived job of the represented company. The company must be verified and the job must have a salary range.

jobId.description: Job id (uuid) of the represented company's posting, from list_employer_jobs.

tools.name: archive_job
tools.description: Archive (unpublish) a job posting of the represented company.

jobId.description: Job id (uuid) of the represented company's posting, from list_employer_jobs.

tools.name: confirm_job_open
tools.description: Confirm the job is still open: it stays publicly visible for 60 days from now.

jobId.description: Job id (uuid) of the represented company's posting, from list_employer_jobs.
